examples.request: A calm, minimal exploration loop in D minor: a soft pad and a sparse bass.
Exploration and combat states. Switching to combat crossfades over one bar and brings in drums; going back takes four bars.
Tension that rises with a danger parameter: the hi-hats get busier and the pad filter opens.
A treasure-found stinger that lands on the next beat over a quiet ambient bed, in three-four time.
A driving groove with euclidean drums and a bass line that varies.
A menu theme with three states (menu, loading, credits) and quick transitions between them.
